title: SemLoc: Structured Grounding of Free-Form LLM Reasoning for Fault Localization
abstract: arXiv:2603.29109v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can describe what a piece of code should compute, but they do so in free-form text. Such text cannot be checked against program executions, and it does not reveal whether a statement is correct. We present SemLoc, which turns LLM reasoning into executable, verifiable semantic constraints. With structured semantic grounding, the LLM writes each property as a constraint with a fixed category, attached to an anchor in the code graph, such as a variable definition, branch, loop, or return. SemLoc inserts each constraint as a runtime check and runs the tests, which yields a semantic violation spectrum over passing and failing tests. Counterfactual verification then patches the code at an anchor and reruns the tests; a patch that a constraint suggests counts as verified only if all tests then pass. translated_title: SemLoc：将自由形式的LLM推理进行结构化语义落地以实现故障定位
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够描述一段代码应该计算什么，但它们是以自由形式的文本来表达的。这类文本无法对照程序执行进行检验，也无法表明某个语句是否正确。我们提出了SemLoc，它将LLM的推理转化为可执行、可验证的语义约束。通过结构化的语义落地，LLM将每个属性写成具有固定类别的约束，并附加到代码图中的锚点上，例如变量定义、分支、循环或返回语句。SemLoc将每个约束作为运行时检查插入并运行测试，从而在通过和失败的测试上生成语义违规谱。随后进行反事实验证：在锚点处对代码打补丁并重新运行测试；只有当所有测试随后都通过时，约束所建议的补丁才被认定为已验证。我们在故障定位任务上研究SemLoc，其中测试作为验证的判定标准，并使用了四个LLM（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: SemLoc将LLM的自由形式推理转化为附加在代码图锚点上的可执行、可验证的语义约束，通过运行时检查和反事实验证实现软件故障定位。
en_tdlr: SemLoc transforms free-form LLM reasoning into executable, verifiable semantic constraints anchored in the code graph, enabling fault localization through runtime checks and counterfactual verification.
